title: True word spoken in jest
html_source:
Variant of: “Ful ofte in game a sooth I have herd saye!”

From Chaucer’s The Cook’s Tale in The Canterbury Tales.

anchor.prefix: report him. Tension makes them nervous. Might 1922#414be the fellow balked me this morning with that horsey woman. Same style of beauty. Quick of him all the same. The stiff walk.
anchor.suffix: . That awful cramp in Lad lane. Something poisonous I ate. Emblem of luck. Why? Probably lost cattle. Mark of the beast. (He closes his eyes an instant.) Bit light in the head. Mon
